sentences.en: Teachers should occasionally let their students blow off some steam.
sentences.zh: 老师应该偶尔让学生放松一下。

sentences.en: I seem to have run out of steam this term.
sentences.zh: 这学期我好像有些力不从心了。

sentences.en: You can also ride on an old, restored, steam train.
sentences.zh: 你也可以乘坐一辆古老的、修复过的蒸汽火车行驶。
